title: Stakeholder
description: A person or a mailbox. Models the real case in which the recipient is NOT a known person (info@, operations@).

contact_type.description: A real distinction: ACCOUNT-C converted from a department mailbox, not from a named contact.
contact_type.$comment: Universal. The preference order over these values is the `stakeholder_preference_order` slot, and it is weak evidence: a monitored department mailbox beat an absent named contact.

decision_role.description: Defaults to unknown. ACCOUNT-B teaches not to assume authority from a job title: the person who replied was not the person who decided.

email_status.description: not_found forces a flag. Never guess an address.
email_status.$comment: Universal and load-bearing. Without the not_found value the agent has no way to report failure and will pattern-guess firstname.lastname@domain, which is the banned anti-pattern.

routed_from.description: The stakeholder who routed the thread here, for example the ACCOUNT-B auto-reply that pointed to the finance analyst.
